pages.title: Marizan Caves & Suites | Santorini
pages.description:
Marizan Caves & Villas are situated in Oia, right at the edge of the famous Caldera, overlooking the sunset and the Aegean Sea.
All Caves are built in the rock on different levels following the traditional style of the island housing, have balconies and a unique view to the volcano & the Caldera.
